purpose: Test a lightweight learned-context codebook selector with training-only OOD gating and safe few-shot installation.
retention_rule: Retain only if the spectral context adapter passes the primary gate for at least three N values and is not worse than the hard coverage gate by more than 0.02 macro future coverage.
claim_boundary: This is a lightweight context-learning prototype, not an end-to-end neural semantic codebook.
All evaluated scenes are already-consumed development data and cannot support a new Final claim.
The OOD threshold is fitted only from training-campaign prototypes in each outer fold.
Every transmitted compact action still requires exact regret safety verification, with exact-action escape on failure.
